description: Cross-trust-domain federation profile with tiered conformance levels C0-C4. See federation-v4.md for level definitions.

payloadSerialization.check: Every cross-domain AgentMessage.payload, handoff-referenced artefact, and action argument object MUST validate as JSON; a fixture whose payload contains a serialized-object blob (e.g. base64 pickle) MUST be rejected by the receiving deployment.

delegationChainMaterialized.check: Every capability token presented across a trust-domain boundary MUST carry delegation.delegationChain with one entry per delegation hop from the human principal to the presenting workload; a token whose chain omits an intermediate hop MUST be refused at use time.

revocationCheckPerHop.check: At every use of a capability token, each delegation hop in the chain MUST be re-checked against revocation state; a token whose intermediate delegator has been revoked MUST be denied even if the leaf token itself is unexpired and unrevoked.
